What is missing or needs you:
- Preschool/Daycare name (title and B08): the school's name isn't in what you sent. Write it in both places.
- Email (B11): no email address is listed for you. Add yours, or leave it blank if the school doesn't need one.
- Phone (B10 and B30): I put your number under (C), meaning cell or mobile. If it's really a work or home number, move it to (W) or (H) in both places.

Notes:
- The form doesn't ask for your address, date of birth or passport details, so I left those out.
- B28 asks who is allowed to collect your nephew. That's for your sister to decide. If she wants you on the list, she can add your name there.
- The form has no signature or date line for the applicant. If the school asks you to sign, check whether they also need a note from your sister saying she authorised you to apply for her.
